display.purpose: The month balance in IBM Plex Sans, and only that. The reason the screen opens.

headline.purpose: Month name and screen headings in Heebo 600.

body.purpose: Row names and field text at the 15px root size.

label.purpose: Captions and meta text in stone-600, 5.5:1 on the page.

numeric.purpose: Every money figure, through .num: IBM Plex Sans with tabular figures. The shekel sign falls back to Heebo, which is intended.

mono.purpose: The system monospace stack, for <code> and the invite code field only. Not a brand face.

shadows.name: hairline
shadows.purpose: Every card at rest. A drawn edge, not a lift.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: The bottom navigation. In dark the soft part becomes 0 6px 20px at 45% black.

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: Sheets and dialogs over a scrim. In dark, 0 24px 60px at 65% black.

motion.name: ease-soft
motion.purpose: The system's only easing token. Fast out, long settle, matching the calm adjective.

breakpoints.name: column
breakpoints.purpose: Sheet max width. Phone first; a wide window centres the phone column.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one committing action on a screen or sheet.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 54px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #2e2b25; color: #f5ead8; font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #474238; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #645c50; }

components.name: Group Chip
components.description: Attaches a row to an existing charge, such as the weekly grocery run. Selected inverts to near-black.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 34px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #eee7db; color: #645c50; font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-chip-on { background: #2e2b25; color: #f5ead8; } .ds-chip-total { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Summary Card
components.description: The signature component: caption, balance, segmented bar, three data columns that are deliberately not cards.
components.html:
נשאר החודש
7,170 ₪
components.css: .ds-summary { background: #f9f4ed; border-radius: 20px; padding: 22px 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(46,43,37,0.14); direction: rtl; font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-cap { font-size: 13px; color: #82796a; } .ds-amount { font-size: 44px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -1px; color: #201e1d; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-bar { display: flex; height: 10px; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; background: #eee7db; } .ds-bar i { display: block; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: A floating pill of three equal segments above the safe area; the active segment takes a light ground.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: #eee7db; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(46,43,37,0.16); direction: rtl; font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav button { flex: 1; min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: none; color: #645c50; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-on { background: #f9f4ed; color: #201e1d; }

components.name: Amount Input
components.description: The hero of the entry sheet: borderless, centred, 52px. A number being typed, not a field in a form.
components.css: .ds-amount-input { width: 100%; border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0; font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 52px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -1px; line-height: 1.1; color: #201e1d; caret-color: #2e2b25; direction: rtl; text-align: center; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-amount-input::placeholder { color: #a19786; }

narrative.overview:
A measuring instrument, not a lifestyle app. The screen opens so that someone standing in a shop, one handed, in daylight, can read one number and put the phone away.

Paper means a real surface: a white card on a light page, with enough tonal step to be seen and a hairline that draws the edge. Ink means the interface itself is achromatic; the only colour is information.

It replaces Organic, a cream and terracotta world that read as childish. The three traits that carried that reading are gone: 28px corners, a cream page where no surface could separate from another, and weight 700 on everything. The discipline that was already right carried over unchanged.
keyCharacteristics: White cards on a near-neutral page, separated by a hairline rather than a shadow
An achromatic interface; colour is reserved for category and for one accent
14px cards, 8px controls, and the only circle left is an avatar
Three weights that mean something: 400 body, 500 chip, 600 heading
Numerals in their own typeface, tabular, so money reads as measurement
One palette file drives both schemes; the neutral ramp inverts, it does not swap
Right to left throughout, phone first, AA contrast as a product requirement

rules.name: The Three Places Rule
rules.body: A category colour appears in exactly three places: the dot beside the category name, the progress bar, and the segment in the summary bar. Never a background, never a tag, never body text.

rules.name: The One Job Rule
rules.body: The accent means 'you can act on this'. If a thing is not interactive, it is not ink blue.

rules.name: The Inverting Ramp Rule
rules.body: Dark mode redefines colour tokens and nothing else. neutral-100 is always the surface and neutral-900 is always the ink, in both schemes, so a component written once is correct in both. The one exception is --nav-active.

rules.name: The Three Weights Rule
rules.body: 400 is body, 500 is a chip, 600 is a heading or an emphasised number. 700 does not appear anywhere.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: tabular-nums on :root and on .num, which also carries the numeral face.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: A card is drawn, not lifted. A shadow means the thing is physically above the page and can be dismissed.

dos: Do keep category colour to the dot, the progress bar and the summary segment.
Do put every figure in .num, which carries both the numeral face and tabular figures.
Do define colour only in src/index.css, in both the :root block and the dark block.
Do use logical properties and never left or right.
Do reach for the hairline to separate a surface, and a shadow only for something that floats.
Do keep touch targets at 54px for a primary action and no less than 34px for a chip.
Do keep the balance the largest thing on the month screen.
donts: Don't use font-weight 700. The scale is 400, 500, 600.
Don't introduce a third accent. Ink blue is interaction, green is good.
Don't put a category colour behind text or into a tag.
Don't add a hover elevation to a card.
Don't return to a cream or beige page.
Don't hardcode a hex value in a component; every colour has a dark counterpart.
